## How was it tested?

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`

## Checklist

- [ ] No content can appear as validated without meeting validation criteria
- [ ] Demo content contains no invented findings, figures or citations
- [ ] Keyboard and screen-reader accessible
- [ ] Docs updated (README / docs/) if behaviour or setup changed
- [ ] Screenshots for UI changes
